work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letters CCXLIV separate the province of Shandong from the diocese of Peking, derogating from Innocent XII’s E sublimi, and erect it into a vicariate apostolic; LF52681 → LF52687 across page number 359 LF52684; complete closing dated die tertia septembris 1839. Own provenance LF52751 excluded. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF52668–52668; the source closing at LF52745–52748 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Ma- iorem sub annulo piscatoris die tertia septem- bris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pontificatus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
